note: M2a tool errors, the M3 task errors and the approval round trip. Every tool error is a normal JSON-RPC result with isError=true; structuredContent.error.code is the machine-readable code and content[0].text is the same object as JSON. Messages are for people; codes and extra fields are the contract. The daemon test builds every errors entry from the real head (isError, the whole structuredContent, content[0].text parsed) and compares it exactly, and compares approval_request to the real elicitation request except for params._meta.progressToken (see approval_request_note).
approval_request_note: params._meta.progressToken is added by rmcp and always equals the request id; clients must accept extra _meta keys and must not pin the id or the token.
